evidence.claim: Same CEPR/VoxEU favourite-longshot analysis as SurePenny.

failure_mode: Identical to SurePenny: upsets are near-total losses. Extra risk: thin 24h volume can mean the 3-15c quote is stale, so the fill may be worse than the displayed ask.
name: Longshot Fader
rule: On an active universe market with 24h volume >= 5,000, when the cheap side's ask is between 0.03 and 0.15 and the opposite side's ask is between 0.85 and 0.97 with displayed spread <= 5c, buy the opposite (85-97c) side, sizing 25% of cash, and hold to settlement.
why: Same bias viewed from the longshot side: when a market is quoting 3-15c for the underdog, the favourite is the side the bias says is cheap. Entering from the longshot quote makes the trigger observable without estimating anything.
